Cooper Black set to become tallest goaltender in NHL history
PREVIEW: Blackhawks Host Canadiens for Friday Night Hockey

away.summary: The Panthers (5-4-2) are missing several key players, including goaltender Jacob Markstrom and forwards Aleksander Barkov, Brad Marchand, and Jonah Gadjovich. Akira Schmid is projected to start in goal after Cooper Black made his NHL debut in the previous game. Sandis Vilmanis and Radko Gudas are likely to return to the lineup after being scratched for Thursday's 4-0 loss at Pittsburgh.

home.summary: The Blackhawks (3-7-0) are dealing with an injury to defenseman Bowen Byram, who has missed three consecutive games and skated in a non-contact jersey on Saturday. Andrew Mangiapane may play in his first game since the season opener after being activated off injured reserve on Friday. Arvid Soderblom could start in goal after Spencer Knight started the past five games.
